title: Committed blur gate is wired into no automated suite — both acceptance criteria (pairs >=15°, sat band <=0.30) are manually-run only
evidence:
ci-local.sh header: "# The gate list mirrors .github/workflows/ci.yml step-for-step — the workflow
# is the spec; never edit one without the other." GATES=(
  "Purity + grep gates (ODN-1)|tools/lint.sh"
  "Core unit tests (the determinism + topology contracts)|mkdir -p bin && odin test core && for i in 1 2 3; do odin test app -out:bin/app-test || exit 1; done && odin test app/render -out:bin/render-test && odin test app/audio -out:bin/audio-test && odin test harness -out:bin/harness-test" ... final entry: "Input parity (T1 across inputs — mouse == touch == controller + CLI arg-validation leg)|tools/harness.sh input-parity && [ -x ./bin/harness ] && ! ./bin/harness input-parity bogus >/dev/null 2>&1" — all 10 entries verified; none invokes tools/blur_gate.py (committed as a new file in this diff).
detail: The PR's two acceptance criteria run only when someone remembers to. Sat band 0.289 is 0.011 under the bar; the wave-final palette reconciliation is expected to touch tokens again. Project conventions demand acceptance criteria become durable tests.
recommended_fix: Add a ci-local/CI gate running tools/blur_gate.py goldens/terminal_types/05000ms.png (add PIL to Dockerfile.ci; mirror into .github/workflows/ci.yml per the script's own rule).

title: D5 chip-skip-under-health-ring behavior has no asserting pin
evidence: view.odin:705: chip_visible := health == .None — the D5 skip rule. palcheck pins presence only, on the healthy-node terminal_types golden: check(count_exact(term, rl.Color{205, 92, 92, 255}) > 30, "type chips: residential triangle", count_exact(term, rl.Color{205, 92, 92, 255})) (plus small_biz/campus/host variants). No check asserts chip glyphs are absent where a health ring is up.
detail: The documented skip-under-ring behavior is pinned only by byte-exact T2 goldens — coverage that evaporates at the next legitimate re-bless; a regression that removes the skip would pass a naive re-bless.
recommended_fix: Add a palcheck check on a node_health golden frame (rings up): assert the chip full-alpha family hexes are absent or per-region-count zero around ringed nodes.

title: No-sprites fallback path gained wash/chip/tier-ring draws that no test executes
evidence: view.odin:724: "// fallback: the pre-7.1 primitive terminals (only when the sprite assets" — the fallback branches now call draw_family_wash/draw_type_chip per role footprint; view.odin:1038: rl.DrawCircleV(c, r * 0.98, tier) — fallback tier wash. The only test forcing sprites absent is wire_path_test.odin:36: v.sprites.ok = false, whose header states the tests "never touch rl — pure math over the path module".
detail: New drawing logic in the belt-and-braces path is compile-checked only (PP_DEBUG/build gates); no golden or palcheck leg renders without the committed sheet, so a fallback regression ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a harness/palcheck leg rendering one frame with the sheet withheld, or unit-pin the pure mappings (terminal_family, router_tier_family thresholds) in a render test.
